name: io.github.gregcastro23/planetary-agents
description: Converse with planetary-agent personas, 360 Moon degree archetypes, minigame brains (Word Duel, Jing Arena), council feeds & culinary debates from alchm.kitchen

environmentVariables.name: PLANETARY_AGENTS_BACKEND_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Planetary Agents FastAPI backend that serves persona chat and agent search. Defaults to http://localhost:8000 for local dev; set to https://api.agents.alchm.kitchen to use the hosted service.

environmentVariables.name: PLANETARY_AGENTS_FRONTEND_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Planetary Agents frontend, used for feed discussions and minigames (word-duel, jing). Defaults to http://localhost:3000; set to https://agents.alchm.kitchen for the hosted feed.

environmentVariables.name: PLANETARY_AGENTS_MCP_MODEL_TIER
environmentVariables.description: Default model tier for persona responses: free | cheap_fast | primary | reflective. Defaults to free for visitors in the ESMS Token Economy.
